# OuterSignal

OuterSignal is a Marketing Services company. OuterSignal is a company that turns e-commerce order data into rich customer intelligence, including VIP detection, B2B leads in DTC, automated personas, and precision segments synced to Meta and Klaviyo. OuterSignal employs 31 people. Headquartered in Wilmington, Delaware, United States.

## About

OuterSignal provides brands with instant VIP-customer detection and real-time, fully enriched customer profile data on every single order. It quickly, securely, and compliantly integrates with any eCommerce platform, allowing brands to monitor and segment customers based on age, gender, location, profession, income, social following, and more.

Whether it’s flagging celebrities, athletes, investors, podcasters, buyers at large retail chains, or simply identifying micro-influencers within a target cohort (i.e. college-aged influencers), OuterSignal finds, flags and activates the customers that matter most while providing unprecedented visibility into the actual customers behind a brand.

# B2B Signals

B2B Signals is a Software Development company. B2B Signals is a company that keeps watching your audience, connected to you or not yet, and reach out the day there's a real reason. They provide weekly feed, drafts ready, approval, and land in your inbox. B2B Signals employs 3 people. Headquartered in Newark, Delaware, United States. Its workforce is distributed across Ukraine and Spain.

## About

Most B2B teams waste 80% of outreach on prospects who aren't buying. B2BSignals fixes that.

We aggregate intent signals across LinkedIn engagement, hiring activity, job changes, website visits, tech installs, and event attendance, then use AI to score, prioritize, and trigger outreach to the accounts that are actually in-market.

No guesswork. No hallucinated scores. Just real signals converted into real pipeline.

From signal detection to booked meeting - one platform.
